title: Pebblet's test posters arrived: five photos and five answers
body: The two test posters are in. Hang Ava (the white daisies) with its rails on, in daylight. Keep people and anything personal out of the photos. Then answer below and add a photo to each field.

questions.title: Rails: how much of the top does the rail cover?
Edges: any white line or anything cut off?
Colours: anything clearly off from the phone?
Lettering: can you read the specimen number from arm's length?
Would you be happy to sell it at €39.95?

photos.label: Ava's top edge with a ruler
Both posters next to the phone

title: Last month's software invoices: two PDFs
body: Two of our tools only show their invoices on their billing pages. Download September's from each and pick them below, as they are. They're filed as mail to invoices@, kept like any invoice.

title: The prototypes zip
body: Pick the zip with the prototypes and their trailers. Taking node_modules out first makes it smaller, but isn't needed: the server leaves those out as it unpacks.

title: Launch Hello Postcards
body: The shop has run on test keys for a week: 40 test orders, no misprints. Recommendation: approve.
grants: Approving lets the product "hello" go public: real customers can see it and buy it.

title: Print API test account: client ID and secret
body: Sign up for a Print API test account at https://portal.printapi.nl/test/ with a @example.com address, then copy the client ID and secret here.

title: Sign in the claude seat "server-2"
body:
A second Claude seat is ready on company-1 but needs you to sign in once.

Open https://claude.ai/oauth/authorize?device=QXJ4-7KPL on any device, sign in with the company account and approve.
Then paste the code it shows you here, or answer "done".

title: Approve the domain example.shop (€12 a year)
body: For the first shop. Registration through Cloudflare, renews yearly. Recommendation: approve.

title: For Robin: our move to your building

items.title: Which unit goes on our invoices?
Can post for us go to your front desk?

thread.text: Letters only. Parcels go to our printer.

items.title: Approve the address change in the register
items.detail: Only needed if you're the registered owner

title: VAT: register for OSS now or at the first EU sale?
body: Registering now costs nothing and saves a scramble later. Recommendation: register now. Reply with now or later.

title: Our transfer impact assessment for your API
body: Their data processing addendum asks for our assessment before 1 November. This is it, short.

mail.subject: Our transfer impact assessment for your API
mail.text:
Dear privacy team,

As your data processing addendum asks, here is our transfer impact assessment for the API we use.

In short: no customer's personal data goes into our prompts, and what we do send is covered by the standard contractual clauses.

Kind regards,
mail.name: Ada

title: Call Print API about our parcel
body: Our test print's parcel has been in transit for six days. Juno asks where it is and whether they can send a new one. It may agree to a reprint at no cost to us. Anything that costs money comes back as an email for you to send.

title: Meet the framing workshop about frame samples
body: They'd rather talk than email about oak frames. Dex asks which sizes they can make by November and what each costs. It agrees to nothing: prices come back as an email for you to send.
